compute_edge_scores: compute edge confidence scores from paired image prediction confidence tensors across a set of edges
get_conf_trf: get a confidence transformation function by mode such as log sqrt m1 or identity
l2_dist: compute weighted L2 squared distance between two tensors along the last dimension
cosine_schedule: compute a cosine learning rate schedule value given normalized progress t and start and end rates
linear_schedule: compute a linear learning rate schedule value given normalized progress t and start and end rates
